title: Chunks as Arms: Multi-Armed Bandit-Guided Sampling for Long-Context LLM Preference Optimization
authors_zh: Shaohua Duan, Pengcheng Huang, Xinze Li, Zhenghao Liu, Xiaoyuan Yi, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun
paper_type_zh: 长上下文偏好数据构造研究
best_for_zh: 适合构造可程序验证的长上下文问答偏好数据，并研究证据选择如何改变回答对分布的读者。
one_line: LongMab uses bandit-guided context chunk rollouts to produce diverse, reward-ranked long-context response pairs for DPO.
LongMab 通过老虎机引导的上下文分块 rollout，为 DPO 生成多样且按奖励排序的长上下文回答对。
why: It makes the context subset that generated an answer part of the preference-data construction process, not merely an inference-time retrieval choice.
inclusion_reason: It turns adaptive context-chunk exploration into programmatically scored chosen/rejected response pairs consumed by DPO.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-context models can overlook evidence in the middle of an input, and synthetic long-context training pairs are often repetitive or factually inconsistent. Full-context response sampling also lets irrelevant passages disrupt generation. For preference optimization, this is a data problem: the quality and diversity of chosen/rejected answers depend on which parts of the context were used to produce the candidate responses.

The paper asks how to construct preference pairs that teach a model to locate and combine useful long-context evidence. It does not simply score completed answers from a fixed prompt. Instead, it makes the selection of context chunks an adaptive data-construction decision, so repeated rollouts can discover useful chunk combinations before the best and worst responses are converted into a DPO record.

长上下文模型可能忽略输入中部的证据，而合成的长上下文训练对常常重复或存在事实不一致。整段上下文的回答采样也会让无关段落干扰生成。对于偏好优化而言，这首先是一个数据问题：被选中和被拒绝回答的质量与多样性，取决于生成候选回答时使用了上下文的哪些部分。

论文要回答的是，如何构造能教会模型定位并组合有用长上下文证据的偏好对。它并非只对固定提示下的完成答案打分，而是把上下文分块的选择变成自适应的数据构造决策，使重复 rollout 能在最佳和最差回答被转换为 DPO 记录之前发现有用的分块组合。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LongMab treats every equal-length context chunk as an arm in a multi-armed bandit. A rollout selects a small subset of chunks, generates an answer from that subset and the question, scores the answer against the known answer, and feeds the resulting reward back to the chunks selected in that rollout. This converts evidence selection into an iterative estimate of which chunks help create correct answers.

The exploration-exploitation balance is then used to improve the preference-data distribution rather than only to choose an answer at test time. After several rollouts, the highest- and lowest-reward generated answers become a preferred and dispreferred pair under the original context and question. The resulting DPO consumer receives answer pairs whose difference reflects learned evidence selection, not just random decoding noise.

LongMab 将每个等长的上下文分块视为多臂老虎机中的一只臂。一次 rollout 选择一个小的分块子集，根据该子集和问题生成回答，依据已知答案为回答打分，并把得到的奖励反馈给本次 rollout 中被选中的分块。这将证据选择转化为一个迭代估计：哪些分块有助于生成正确回答。

随后，探索与利用之间的平衡被用来改善偏好数据分布，而不只是用于测试时选择一个答案。经过多次 rollout 后，在原始上下文和问题下生成的最高奖励与最低奖励回答会成为偏好和非偏好的一对。由此得到的 DPO 消费者接收到的回答对，其差异反映了学习到的证据选择，而不只是随机解码噪声。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method splits a long context into chunks and initializes each chunk's expected reward with a probe-based signal. At each of 30 rollouts, an upper-confidence-bound rule selects four 1,500-token chunks. The base model answers the question using only those chunks. The reward is the average of substring exact match on the response and F1 on the extracted answer, compared with the ground-truth answer.

For every selected chunk, LongMab updates its selection count and incremental expected reward, so later rollouts can both revisit promising evidence and try insufficiently explored chunks. The highest- and lowest-reward answers among the rollout candidates form a DPO pair paired with the original long context and question. The reported data are built from MuSiQue training questions whose contexts are augmented with random Wikipedia documents to 8K–16K tokens.

该方法把长上下文切分为分块，并以基于探针的信号初始化每个分块的预期奖励。在 30 次 rollout 的每一次中，上置信界规则选择四个各含 1,500 个词元的分块。基础模型只使用这些分块回答问题。奖励是回答上的子串精确匹配与提取答案的 F1 的平均值，二者均与标准答案比较。

对于每个被选中的分块，LongMab 更新其选择次数和增量式预期奖励，使之后的 rollout 既能重新访问有希望的证据，也能尝试尚未充分探索的分块。rollout 候选中最高奖励和最低奖励的回答形成一个 DPO 对，并与原始长上下文和问题配对。报告的数据来自 MuSiQue 训练问题，其上下文通过随机 Wikipedia 文档扩展到 8K–16K 个词元。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On five long-context question-answering tasks, LongMab improves the reported average F1 for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to 47.43. The strongest listed DPO baseline, LongFaith-PO, reaches 43.15; for Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, LongMab reaches 42.26 while the strongest listed DPO baseline reaches 37.92. The paper therefore reports gains exceeding four points over its compared preference-optimization methods.

Ablations make the construction claim more specific. Removing UCB selection lowers average F1 from 47.43 to 44.19 on Llama and from 42.26 to 38.76 on Qwen; removing the initialization also lowers performance. The authors further report that the selected preferred answers improve by more than six points over the random-chunk and full-context variants, while response diversity remains comparable to random chunk sampling. These results support, but do not independently prove, the value of the bandit-built pairs.

在五个长上下文问答任务上，LongMab 将 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 报告的平均 F1 提升到 47.43。所列最强的 DPO 基线 LongFaith-PO 达到 43.15；对于 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct，LongMab 达到 42.26，而所列最强的 DPO 基线达到 37.92。因此，论文报告相对所比较的偏好优化方法有超过四个点的提升。

消融实验使数据构造的主张更具体。移除 UCB 选择后，Llama 的平均 F1 从 47.43 降至 44.19，Qwen 从 42.26 降至 38.76；移除初始化同样会降低性能。作者还报告，相比随机分块和整段上下文变体，选中的偏好回答提升超过六个点，而回答多样性与随机分块抽样相当。这些结果支持老虎机构造回答对的价值，但不能独立证明它。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The new object is not a generic reward model or a context-retrieval module. LongMab stores a causal construction path from chunk selection through generated answer to programmatic reward, and uses that path to decide which pair DPO will consume. Its bandit state turns repeated answer rollouts into evidence about the utility of different context segments for this particular question.

This matters because earlier long-context preference pipelines can use the whole context, fixed relevant chunks, or random chunk combinations. LongMab instead makes the sample-generation policy responsive to prior answer quality while preserving exploration. The paper's contribution is thus a data-generation policy for preference records: it decides which evidence conditions produce positive and negative answers before training, rather than only changing a DPO loss after the records exist.

新的对象并不是一个通用奖励模型或上下文检索模块。LongMab 保存了一条从分块选择、经过生成回答、到程序化奖励的因果构造路径，并用这条路径决定 DPO 将消费哪一对回答。其老虎机状态把重复的回答 rollout 转化为证据，说明不同上下文片段对这个具体问题的效用。

这很重要，因为早期长上下文偏好流程可以使用完整上下文、固定的相关分块或随机分块组合。LongMab 则使样本生成策略能响应此前的回答质量，同时保留探索。因而，论文的贡献是一项偏好记录的数据生成策略：它在训练之前决定什么样的证据条件会产生正负回答，而不是只在记录已经存在后修改 DPO 损失。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The reward requires a ground-truth answer and relies on exact-match and F1 proxies, so it is not directly suitable for open-ended generation where correctness cannot be string matched. Thirty rollouts may be costly when contexts are much longer than the reported 8K–16K range, and the authors only study models mainly between 7B and 14B parameters. Wikipedia augmentation may not represent the noise, source relationships, or legal constraints of production corpora. Although code and a data download path are public, any reuse must independently check the upstream dataset, model, and synthetic-context licenses.

该奖励需要标准答案，并依赖精确匹配和 F1 代理，因此并不直接适合无法用字符串匹配正确性的开放式生成。对于远长于报告的 8K–16K 范围的上下文，30 次 rollout 可能代价高昂；作者主要只研究了 7B 到 14B 参数规模的模型。Wikipedia 扩展也未必能代表生产语料的噪声、来源关系或法律约束。尽管代码和数据下载路径是公开的，任何复用仍必须独立检查上游数据集、模型和合成上下文的许可证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This is essential for practitioners whose long-context records have reference answers and whose main bottleneck is constructing credible DPO pairs rather than inventing a new optimizer. It supplies a transparent data schema, a deterministic terminal reward, and a release with scripts for probe generation, rollouts, pair construction, DPO, and evaluation. Before adopting it, decide whether reference-answer reward, chunk size, rollout budget, and synthetic-noise process represent the intended training environment; these choices determine the distribution of both chosen and rejected responses.
对于拥有带参考答案的长上下文记录、且主要瓶颈是构造可信 DPO 对而不是发明新优化器的实践者，这是一篇必读论文。它提供透明的数据结构、确定性的终止奖励，以及包含探针生成、rollout、回答对构造、DPO 和评测脚本的发布。在采用前，应判断参考答案奖励、分块大小、rollout 预算和合成噪声过程是否代表预期训练环境；这些选择决定了被选中和被拒绝回答的分布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3–5 as a single construction chain. The key details are the reward definition, UCB update, selected-chunk count, rollout count, and the fact that only the extreme-reward answers become a pair. Compare Table 1 with Table 2: the former reports downstream gains, while the latter tests whether bandit selection rather than merely chunking context produces the useful data. The public repository specifies expected raw fields, the probe, rollout, pair-construction, training, and evaluation commands; preserve their versions and seeds when auditing a recreated dataset.
应将第 3 至第 5 节视为一条完整的构造链来阅读。关键细节是奖励定义、UCB 更新、所选分块数量、rollout 数量，以及只有极端奖励的回答才形成一对这一事实。比较表 1 和表 2：前者报告下游增益，后者检验是否是老虎机选择而非仅仅切分上下文产生了有用数据。公开仓库规定了预期原始字段、探针、rollout、回答对构造、训练和评测命令；审计重建的数据集时应保存其版本和随机种子。
